summary: syrp-plugin-api (increment 1): parameters. ParamRange (NormalisableRange semantics: step, skew, centre, symmetric skew, snap), the ParamSpec builder (id, name, range, default, unit, text conversion, smoothing, automatable, group), ParamLayout assigning dense ParamIndex values in registration order with prepare-time id lookup, and Params (one contiguous AtomicF32 array); new error domain errors/plugin.toml (SYRP-PLUGIN-0001 to 0003).
